payload.name: Mud Pie
payload.description: Tokkapchi will move to the center of the arena and create a Mud Slime add. The add cannot be killed, only pushed via damage. Keep all of the boss's area of effect attacks away from the Mud Slime, including the periodic puddle explosion. Allowing the Mud Slime to be hit with attacks will cause it to grow, causing it to deal more damage when it finally detonates. After roughly 45 seconds, the Mud Slime will cast Corrupture, dealing damage to the entire party based on how large it became. If the Mud Slime was not allowed to grow at all, Corrupture instead only hits melee range. If the Mud Slime grows once, Corrupture will deal moderate party-wide damage. If the Mud Slime grows twice, it will explode immediately for very high damage while also inflicting a cleansable Damage Down.

payload.name: Fodder
payload.description: Griaule will move to the center of the arena and summon five untargetable Painted Sapling adds that will then tether to him. These tethers can and should be intercepted by players, and after a short time, the adds will bestow a the Growing buff to whomever they were tethered to. To "intercept", a player needs to stand between the Painted Sapling and Griaule, to break the beam's line-of-sight to the boss. If successful, the beam will visually switch from Griaule to the player, and player will receive Growing buff. The Growing buff increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken, along with physically increasing the target's size. Players who gain a second stack of Growing will have it replaced with Full-Grown, which further increases the benefits gained from Growing, but the boss will continue to gain stacks. WARNING: If Growing buff is allowed to reach 5 stacks on Griaule, then the next Tiiimbeeer will instantly wipe the party even at full health.

payload.name: Coiling Ivy

The adds need to be targeted and destroyed to remove the debuff. The melee or short-range players can target their own add to break free, while ranged could help free other players from range, after freeing themselves. If not freed, the player will remained rooted/bound indefinitely and won't be able to move out of other attacks, such as Swinge.

payload.name: Funambulist's Fantasia
payload.description: Aenc Thon will move to the back of the arena, knock all players back to the entrance of the arena, and creates a massive gap in the center of the room. A single, narrow and winding path is the only way across the pit. Players that fall into the pit are teleported back to the start and stunned with Fool's Tumble, but are otherwise unharmed. Players' mobility and teleporation skills cannot be used to bypass the maze. At the same time, Aenc Thon will become surrounded in a barrier, summon the Liar's Lyre, and the two will begin casting Finale. If running the dungeon with the Trust system, each of the Scions will react differently to this: Thancred will run until the first turning point, at which point he'll jump across using using Rough Divide. Urianger will walk to the edge of the pit, then stand still and wait for someone else to make it across, at which point he'll cast Aetherial Manipulation to teleport himself to that person. Alisaie and Crystal Exarch use Sprint to run the whole thing without stopping. Y'shtola will also use Sprint, but to increase her walking speed, rather than running full-tilt. Minfilia and Alphinaud will cautiously and slowly walk. Alphinaud will eventually speed up, but Minfilia does not and will not make it to the end before Finale casts.
